statement: Windows and MacOS share dockable toolbars, trays, Materials and Ruby Console.
superiority: Scriptable workspace layouts and shareable workspace files.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/sketchup/user-interface Acceptance sketch: Dock three trays, restart, and compare the saved workspace layout; positions and sizes persist exactly.

statement: Tabs, floating windows and persistent app window in one instance.

source.ref: Multiple document tabs and floating windows

superiority: Same plus cross-model copy and paste of components with provenance.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Open two models in tabs, edit each, undo in one; the other is unaffected, and a floating window edits the correct model.

superiority: Context-aware toolbars that adapt to the task.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Create a custom toolbar, add 5 commands, restart; the toolbar and command order persist.

statement: Panels and trays hold model management tools.

source.ref: Default Tray panels (Entity Info, Materials, Components, Styles, Tags, Scenes, Shadows, Fog, Soften, Instructor, Outliner)

superiority: Fully dockable panel system with user layouts per task.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Open each listed panel, close and reopen; each shows the model data it documents and its state persists.

statement: Default shortcuts with custom assignments, import and export.
superiority: Shortcut emulation sets for other programs so users keep muscle memory.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/default-keyboard-shortcuts https://help.sketchup.com/en/creating-and-editing-shortcuts Acceptance sketch: Assign a key to a command, press it; the command runs. Import and export a shortcut set and compare.

source.ref: Preferences (General, Graphics, Files, Compatibility, Shortcuts, Drawing, Template, Workspace)

superiority: Preferences sync through the account and are versioned.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/sketchup/files-and-general Acceptance sketch: Change 10 preferences, restart; values persist; Migrate Preferences carries them to a new install.

statement: A search box finds tools, commands and extensions.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Search for 20 tool and command names; each returns the expected tool and activating it works.

superiority: Context menus are scriptable and user-configurable.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Right-click each entity type and compare menu items to the documented list.

statement: Mouse mapping, touchpad modifiers (2027.0), trackpad controls and 3Dconnexion.
superiority: Fully remappable input including 3D mice and gestures.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/trackpad-controls https://help.sketchup.com/en/release-notes/sketchup-desktop-20270 Acceptance sketch: Replay recorded wheel, drag and touchpad modifier gestures; resulting camera matches reference within 1e-6.

superiority: Meets WCAG 2.2 AA with documented conformance evidence.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/sketchup/vpat Acceptance sketch: Run a screen-reader and keyboard-only pass over core workflows; every control is reachable and labeled.

superiority: Interactive tutorial that verifies each step on the real model.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/sketchup/tips-and-tricks Acceptance sketch: A new-user walkthrough completes the documented first tasks without error.

statement: Contextual notifications for onboarding, features, urgent alerts since 2026.1.2.
superiority: All notifications can be disabled by policy.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Set Show urgent messages only; non-urgent notifications are suppressed and urgent ones still show.

statement: Guidelines to improve performance: purge, tags, components, graphics.
superiority: Streaming, LOD and instancing keep large models interactive.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/sketchup/improving-graphics-performance https://help.sketchup.com/en/cleaning-bloated-models Acceptance sketch: Open a 500 MB reference model; first view appears within the budget and orbit stays above 30 fps.

statement: New HLR engine is much faster for vector output.
superiority: Exact hidden-line on 100,000 elements in under one second.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Generate vector linework for a complex reference model; time is at least 5 times faster than the classic engine with equal linework within 0.1 pt.

statement: System requirements and graphics API choices.
superiority: Automatic capability detection with a software fallback path.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/graphics-card-driver-issues Acceptance sketch: Launch on a reference GPU and on the fallback classic engine; both render the test scene with equal output.

superiority: Local-only reports by default and automatic recovery of the last committed operation.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Force a controlled crash; a report with a stack and a recovery file is produced and the next launch offers recovery.

superiority: Unit-aware expressions everywhere with dimensional analysis.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/measuring-distance Acceptance sketch: Convert test values among inches, feet, meters and millimetres; results equal exact conversion factors.

statement: Silent install and extension loading policy.
superiority: Group-policy and MSIX/pkg deployment with signed configuration.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/extensions-loading-policy Acceptance sketch: Run the silent installer with documented flags; product is installed and extension policy honored.
